blurb: Commisso Estate Winery is situated on a 75-year-old vineyard at the top of the Niagara Escarpment. Guests can enjoy wine tastings, participate in an interactive tasting experience, and attend live music and pairing events. The winery also offers a Quarterly Wine Club with perks including free tastings, event discounts, and B&B discounts.
